english: 21-25. Once (Chāyā) was requested by (Yama), the hungry son of Vivasvān, for cooked food. But it was not given immediately to him, though he had requested for it. Then Chāyā was kicked by him. She then cursed him, “Since out of childishness you kicked me with the foot, you shall certainly become lame of foot.” On being cursed thus, he became distressed with pain and lamented grievously. In the meantime, O Vyāsa, Vibhāvasu (Sun) who moved among the Planets favouring the worlds and encircling the Earth, saw his son lame. Vibhāvasu said thus: “O dear one, what is this painful suffering unto you? O sinless one, whence has this distress been contacted by you?”
